headline: India And Nepal Launch New Ayodhya To Janakpur Railway Service
seoTitle: Ayodhya To Janakpur Railway Service Launched
metaDescription: India and Nepal have inaugurated a new weekly train service connecting Ayodhya Cantt and Janakpur Dham to strengthen bilateral cultural and rail ties.
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Modi and officials inaugurated the Saryu-Kamala Express connecting Ayodhya Cantt and Janakpur Dham.
The new cross-border railway operates on a weekly schedule featuring ten designated stations along the route.
The project is part of a broader package of connectivity and energy agreements signed between the two nations.
aiContextParagraph: The launch of the Saryu-Kamala Express marks a new development in connectivity between India and Nepal. Inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi during a high-level state meeting, the rail service creates a direct link between Ayodhya Cantt and Janakpur Dham. According to reports, the train is scheduled to depart weekly on Mondays and consists of ten stops. The initiative is intended to facilitate stronger cultural and social ties between the two countries. Beyond the railway launch, the state visit included the signing of additional agreements focused on energy and infrastructure, highlighted by a significant financial package. Regional leadership, including Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, has characterized the project as a milestone for cross-border cooperation and historical cultural relations. The service follows prior approvals from Indian railway authorities earlier in the month to formalize the weekly transit connection.
whyItIsViral: The story is highly viral, covered by three independent major outlets with a rapid pace of reporting following the official inauguration.
